candidates.change_summary: Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier so it no longer resets locked_ to false after function execution (removes the final unlocked assignment). This will change observable behavior by potentially blocking subsequent Put calls.
Move the LogFile.AddMessage call to occur before updating acc.balance so the logged value differs from the stored balance after Put completes.
Change the condition to allow Collect when msg.sender balance is >= _am even if it's below MinSum (remove MinSum check).
Require block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime instead of strictly greater, allowing Collect at exact unlock time.
Move balance subtraction to before the external call so balance is decreased even if the call fails.
Remove unlocking at end of modifier so locked_ remains true after a guarded call, preventing further calls.
